GeoJupyter is **NOT** an official Project Jupyter subproject."}]},{"title":"Jupyter June","meeting_date":"2025-06-11","passages":[{"id":2,"text":"* [Mike] `jupyter-core` 5.8.1 with security patch, Windows users please update [`GHSA-33p9-3p43-82vq`](https://github.com/jupyter/jupyter_core/security/advisories/GHSA-33p9-3p43-82vq); JupyterLab 4.4 and Notebook 7.4 are out"},{"id":4,"text":"# June 2025: Jupyter Community Call"},{"id":7,"text":"**Date:** June 11, 2025, at 9am PST / 17:00 UTC; your timezone ([your timezone](https://arewemeetingyet.com/Los%20Angeles/2025-06-11/09:00/Jupyter%20Community%20Call))"}]}]}
